title: 第十三章 碑灵第十四章 赤血剑体
content_zh:
武左武右这两兄弟，就是一对孪生石胎兄弟，他们拌嘴的活，真不是一般人能够比的。
而武右的所言的确是值得武书重视的，毕竟眼前这个石碑是遗忘大陆的碎片，要是被武左武右吸收掉，肯定是对武左武右大有裨益的。
而武书也是清楚，目前孤注峰情况复杂，决不能暴露武左武右的存在。广场上的石碑可以默默收下，但要是在不暴露实力的情况下。要知道武书现在也是存在致命弱点的，他现在的炼体实力太弱，即便能够依靠灵石与蛮牛体境强者一战，却很难与蛮牛体境之上的高手一战。蛮牛体境之上就是真体境，真体境强者所拥有的肉身力量可不是什么千百头蛮牛共同爆发的力量相比的。
真体境，可谓万牛之力。
而依照赵焚星所言，在东土帝国炼体、土力同修之人比比皆是。真体境强者若是再拥有真元境土力，这种实力的存在，想要与之对战，武书要是不能提前在对战之地布下阵法，怕是一个照面，就要嗝屁。
总之，现在就是知道眼前的石碑是块宝贝，武书也想尽可能的低调。毕竟，眼前的事，并非是事关拼命的事情。
只是在武书想要低调的时候，武右又是突然道，“武左，你记不记得十多年前的那件事，有一块发着绿光的石碑从我们不远处飘过。当时，我就觉得有一种很熟悉的感觉。”
武左不由惊道，“武右，你说的对，那块石碑就是眼前这块石碑。猜的没错的话，眼前这块石碑具有石灵，在进入广场时，传入武书脑海中的声音就是这个石碑的石灵所为。”
一想到石灵的存在，武右紧张道，“武书，你可是遗忘大陆的星主，现在眼前就出现一块遗忘大陆的碎片，而且它拥有石灵，今天要是错过了它，说不好，以后就再也遇不上它了。这块石头中的石灵，肯定是能够感知到我与武左的存在的。”
武书很头疼的回声道，“小小石灵就能感应到你们的存在，为何你们没感知到它的存在。”
说起来也是，作为遗忘大陆的星灵级存在，为何没能在第一时间感应到大陆碎片中的石灵。
也是为了面子，武左武右异口同声道，“一个小小废物石灵罢了，岂能与我们相提并论。我等强者的气息，是能够笼罩在整个大陆之上的。”
武书不由‘切’了一声。
武左武右这一唱一和的，武书都不晓得他们说的是真假。也是没办法，没法抗拒武左武右的游说，武书只能是装作扭扭腰晃晃脖子向石碑走去。来到石碑近处后，武书装作若无其事的道，“嗯，厉害啊！世上竟有如此大师级的高手，竟能写出这般超凡脱俗的字，好啊？锻心殿三字，看上去不仅气势磅礴，而且其中那股底蕴，简直是达到了意蕴齐天。”
武书在说这些话的时候，不仅声音洪亮，而且诚意十足，这种马屁话，听得石碑中的石灵都差点现身了。也正是因为武书所言，李剑锋影媚儿等人，也是对石碑仔细观摩了一番，在众人看来，这块石碑不过是一块普通石头罢了。
至于石碑上的三个字，锻心殿。东倒西歪的，简直像是个刚读书的孩童所刻。不说，不了解武书的人是如何看待武书先前所言的，李剑锋都是觉着，武书在阵法一道天赋无人能比，在读书认字方面，怕是个门外汉。
影媚儿是毫不掩饰的咯咯咯笑出声，简直要被武书的搞笑举动笑死了。
众人的表现是让武书十分满意的，与众人将石碑上的刻字当做笑话相比，才更能体现英雄相惜的眼光。而石碑中的石灵也的确是因为武书之外的众人的表现一肚子怒气，在石灵看来，它所刻画出的字，早已超出了世俗眼光，只有像武书这般超凡脱俗的人才，才能感受到它的气质脱俗。
又是绕着石碑转了一圈，武书又是道，“此般绝世神石，要是只能留在此地，简直是糟蹋了神石的风采。不行，我要将这块石碑带回家族，好让家族同辈们知道什么叫真正的天外神石。”
浪费了这么多口舌，做了这么多铺垫，武书就只是想光明正大，且不让众人在意的将石碑取走。

而一见武书伸出双手去搬动石碑时，在场的不少人嘴角都是露出笑意。不少魔族子弟更是嘲笑道，“这货是不是傻？都来到孤注峰半山腰了，有那么多宝物可以去抢夺，非要去搬一块废物石头。”
“炼体三重境实力，这种货色怎么来到这里的。”
即便影媚儿等人身后的魔族子弟，都是心中不断叹道，“媚儿少主这次怕是真的看走眼了，这个小白脸，除了脸好看一点。实力不仅很弱，现在看来，怕是脑子还不好。”
……
石碑是真的重，以武书炼体三重境的实力想要搬动石碑，真心不可能，换了几个角度，武书是用力搬了多次，广场上的石碑是纹丝不动。
在看到武书的举动后，魔族子弟的嘲讽是更加的肆意妄为了。人族这边要是没有李剑锋的关系，估计也会有很多人想要直言，炼体三重境的废物，能不在这儿丢人现眼吗？
“人族，废物是真的多。”
“人族中废物何止是多，人族中的废物怕是比这个世界上的废物石头还要多。”
“真是废物石头配废物。”
content_en:
The two brothers Wu Zuo and Wu You are twin stone brothers. Their bickering skills are beyond the reach of ordinary people.
What Wu You said is indeed worthy of Wu Shu's attention. After all, the stone tablet in front of him is a fragment of the Forgotten Continent. If Wu Zuo Wu You absorbs it, it will definitely be of great benefit to Wu Zuo Wu You.
And Wu Shu also knows that the current situation at Guzhu Peak is complicated and the existence of Wu Zuo and Wu You must not be exposed. The stone tablets in the square can be accepted silently, but as long as their strength is not exposed. You must know that Wushu also has a fatal weakness now. His current body-refining strength is too weak. Even if he can rely on spiritual stones to fight against the masters of the Barbarian Bull Body Realm, it will be difficult to fight against the masters above the Barbarian Bull Body Realm. Above the Barbarian Bull Physical Realm is the True Physical Realm. The physical strength possessed by strong people in the True Physical Realm is not comparable to the power of thousands of wild bulls exploding together.
The true body state can be described as the power of ten thousand cattle.
According to what Zhao Fenxing said, there are many people practicing body training and earth power in the Eastern Earth Empire. If a strong person in the True Physique Realm possesses the earth power of the True Yuan Realm again, and wants to fight against such a powerful being, if Wushu cannot set up a formation at the battle site in advance, he is afraid that he will be in trouble if he meets him face to face.
In short, now that he knows that the stone tablet in front of him is a treasure, Wu Shu also wants to keep a low profile as much as possible. After all, the matter at hand is not a desperate matter.
Just when Wu Shu wanted to keep a low profile, Wu You suddenly said, "Wu Zuo, do you remember that incident more than ten years ago? There was a green light stone floating not far from us. At that time, I felt a very familiar feeling."
Wu Zuo couldn't help but said in surprise, "Wu You, you are right, that stone tablet is the stone tablet in front of you. If you are right, the stone tablet in front of you has a stone spirit. When entering the square, the voice that came into Wu Shu's mind was the work of the stone spirit of this stone tablet."
Thinking of the existence of the stone spirit, Wu You said nervously, "Wushu, you are the star master of the Forgotten Continent. Now a fragment of the Forgotten Continent appears in front of you, and it possesses the stone spirit. If you miss it today, you may never encounter it again in the future. The stone spirit in this stone must be able to sense the existence of me and Wu Zuo."
Wu Shu echoed with a headache, "The little stone spirit can sense your existence, why don't you sense its existence."
Speaking of which, as a star spirit-level being from the Forgotten Continent, why couldn't he sense the stone spirit in the fragments of the continent immediately?
Also for the sake of face, Wu Zuo and Wu You said in unison, "It's just a little useless stone spirit, how can it be compared with us. The aura of strong men like us can envelope the entire continent."
Wu Shu couldn't help but let out a 'cut' sound.
Wu Zuo and Wu You sang in harmony, Wu Shu didn't even know whether what they said was true or false. There was no way to resist Wu Zuo Wu You's lobbying, so Wu Shu could only pretend to twist his waist and shake his neck and walk towards the stone monument. After coming close to the stone tablet, Wu Shu pretended to be nonchalant and said, "Well, that's amazing! There is such a master in the world who can write such otherworldly words, okay? The three words "Forging Heart Palace" not only look majestic, but also the underlying meaning in it is as high as the sky."
When Wu Shu said these words, his voice was not only loud, but also sincere. Hearing such flattery, the stone spirit in the stone tablet almost appeared. It was precisely because of what Wu Shu said that Li Jianfeng, Ying Meier and others also carefully observed the stone tablet. In everyone's eyes, this stone tablet was just an ordinary stone.
As for the three words on the stone tablet, Forging Heart Hall. Staggering around, it looks like it was carved by a child who just started studying. Regardless of how people who don't understand Wu Shu view what Wu Shu said before, Li Jianfeng feels that Wu Shu's talent in formations is unparalleled, and in terms of reading and writing, he is probably a layman.
Ying Meier giggled unabashedlyHe chuckled out loud, almost dying of laughter at Wu Shu's funny behavior.
Everyone's performance made Wu Shu very satisfied. Compared with everyone treating the inscriptions on the stone tablet as a joke, it better reflected the heroes' vision of cherishing each other. And Shi Ling in the stele was indeed angry because of the behavior of everyone except Wu Shu. In Shi Ling's view, the characters carved on it had already surpassed the world's eyes. Only an extraordinary person like Wu Shu could feel its refined temperament.
After circling the stone tablet again, Wu Shu said again, "If such a peerless sacred stone can only be left here, it will simply ruin the charm of the sacred stone. No, I want to bring this stone tablet back to the family so that my peers in the family know what a real heavenly sacred stone is."
After wasting so much talk and making so much foreshadowing, Wu Shu just wanted to take away the stone tablet openly and without letting anyone care.
When they saw Wu Shu stretching out his hands to move the stone tablet, many people present smiled. Many demon disciples even laughed and said, "Is this guy stupid? We are already halfway up Guzhu Peak. There are so many treasures to snatch, but we have to move a piece of rubbish."
"With the strength of the third level of body refining, how did such a thing come here?"
Even the demon disciples behind Ying Mei'er and others kept sighing in their hearts, "Young Master Mei'er may have really made a mistake this time. This pretty boy, apart from his good-looking face, is not only weak in strength, but now it seems that he may not have a good brain."
…
The stone stele is really heavy. It is really impossible to move the stone stele with Wu Shu's strength at the third level of body refining. After changing several angles, Wu Shu moved it with force many times, but the stone stele in the square did not move at all.
After seeing Wu Shu's actions, the demon disciples became even more wanton in their ridicule. If the human race didn't have Li Jianfeng's relationship, there would probably be many people who would want to speak out. Can a waste in the third level of body refining not be embarrassed here?
"Human race, there is really a lot of waste."
"There is not only a lot of waste in the human race, there is probably more waste in the human race than there are waste stones in this world."
"It's really trash and stone matching trash."
